pull_request.title: Return 404 for unknown orders
pull_request.body: Closes #182. Unknown ids raised a 500; they should be a 404.

files.patch:
@@ -30,4 +30,6 @@ def get_order(oid):
-    return repo.load(oid)
+    order = repo.load(oid)
+    if order is None:
+        raise NotFound(oid)
+    return order

expect.notes: Says in one sentence that the diff does what it says. May note the implication that callers previously handling a 500 will now see a 404. Does not manufacture a concern.
